name: com.cars-data/car-specs-api
title: cars-data.com — Car Specs API
description: Search, compare & filter 103,372 car variants — 224 specs, 20 languages. Free demo, no key; x402.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your cars-data.com API key> — OPTIONAL. Without it this server answers a fixed 40-car demo (every spec, every photo, 20 languages); a demo key, issued in one click, covers the same 40 cars over REST. Four tools reach the full 103,372-variant catalogue with no key and no account at all, paid per call under x402 v2 on Base (USDC): search_catalogue $0.005, filter_catalogue $0.005, get_specs_full $0.05 and compare_full $0.1 — the same four operations at the same prices as the Apify Actor. Keys and licensed exports: https://cars-data.com/en/api/for-ai-agents
